title: Build and Release Engineer
summary: A build and release engineer makes sure code from many developers compiles, passes tests and ships as a versioned release on a fixed schedule. They sit in the engineering productivity or release team, focusing on build systems, CI pipelines, branching and release trains rather than on running cloud infrastructure.
dailyDuties: Fix broken builds and keep the CI pipeline green
Cut release branches and tag versions on the release calendar
Maintain build scripts and speed up slow builds
Publish and clean up artifacts in the artifact repository
Chair go/no-go checks with development and QA leads
Automate release steps with Python or shell scripts

skills.expectation: Build and maintain CI pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions
Own build scripts in Maven, Gradle, CMake or similar and keep builds fast
Run branching, versioning, tagging and the release calendar
Manage branches, merges and tags across many repositories
Publish and manage build artifacts in Artifactory or Nexus
Script build and release automation in Python or Bash
Script build and release automation in Python or Bash
Run and troubleshoot Linux build servers and agents
Track release items and blockers in Jira
Wire test suites and quality gates into the pipeline
Add dependency scanning and SBOMs to builds
Agree release dates and go/no-go with development and QA leads

certifications.why: Covers pipelines and release on Azure DevOps
